kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تصاعدت (form VI)
# تَصَاعَدْتُ (taṣāʕadtu) /ta.sˤaː.ʕad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# تَصَاعَدْتَ (taṣāʕadta) /ta.sˤaː.ʕad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# تَصَاعَدْتِ (taṣāʕadti) /ta.sˤaː.ʕad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَصَاعَدَ (taṣāʕada)
# تَصَاعَدَتْ (taṣāʕadat) /ta.sˤaː.ʕa.dat/: third-person
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
